grammar_archive.topic: Past Perfect Continuous (o'tmishdagi boshqa harakatdan oldingi davomiylikni ta'kidlash)

parts.1: ⏳ Past Perfect Continuous zamoni: Umumiy tushuncha (1/5) 📌 Past Perfect Continuous (O'tmish tugallangan davomli zamon) o'tmishda sodir bo'lgan boshqa bir harakatdan oldin ma'lum bir vaqt davomida uzluksiz davom etgan jarayonni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi. Bu zamonda asosiy diqqat-e'tibor harakatning qancha vaqt davom etganligiga va uning davomiyligini ta'kidlashga qaratiladi. Ya'ni o'tmishdagi ikkinchi harakat ro'y berguniga qadar birinchi harakat muayyan muddat davom etgan bo'ladi. Ushbu grammatik qoida o'zbek tiliga ko'pincha "...-ayotgan edi" yoki "...-ib kelayotgan edi" shaklida tarjima qilinadi. 💡 Misollar: • They had been waiting for two hours before the bus arrived. (Avtobus kelguniga qadar ular ikki soat davomida kutishayotgan edi.) • She had been studying English for three years before she moved to London. (U Londonga ko'chib o'tishidan oldin uch yil davomida ingliz tilini o'rganib kelayotgan edi.) 📝 Keyingi qismlarda ushbu zamonning darak, inkor va so'roq gap tuzilishlarini batafsil ko'rib chiqamiz. Bizni kuzatishda davom eting!
parts.2: ⏳ Past Perfect Continuous: Darak gaplar (2/5) 📌 Darak gap formulasi: Subject + had + been + Verb-ing (Barcha egalar — I, you, he, she, it, we, they uchun o'zgarmasdan had been ishlatiladi.) 💡 Ushbu zamon o'tmishdagi boshqa bir harakat sodir bo'lguniga qadar ma'lum bir harakatning qancha vaqt davom etganini ta'kidlash uchun xizmat qiladi. 📖 Misollar: 🗣️ She had been waiting for two hours when the bus finally arrived. (Avtobus nihoyat kelganida, u ikki soatdan beri kutayotgan edi.) 🗣️ They had been playing football before it started to rain. (Yomg'ir yog'ishni boshlashidan oldin ular futbol o'ynashayotgan edi.) 🗣️ I had been working at that company for five years when I got promoted. (Lavozimim oshirilganida, men u kompaniyada besh yildan beri ishlayotgan edim.) 🗣️ He was very tired because he had been running in the park. (U juda charchagan edi, chunki bog'da yugurib yurgan edi.) ❗ Muhim eslatma: Ko'pchilik o'quvchilar been so'zini tushirib qoldirishadi. Shunchaki had working deyish xatodir. Harakatning davomiyligini ko'rsatish uchun albatta had been + V-ing birikmasini to'liq ishlating!
parts.3: 📚 Past Perfect Continuous: Inkor gaplar (3/5) 📌 Inkor gapning yasalish formulasi: Ega + had not (hadn't) + been + V-ing 💡 O'tmishdagi ma'lum bir vaqt yoki boshqa bir harakatgacha jarayonning davom etmaganini ta'kidlash uchun hadn't been birikmasi ishlatiladi. 🗣️ Misollar: 🔹 They hadn't been waiting for long when the train arrived. (Poyezd kelganida ular uzoq kutishmayotgan edi.) 🔹 She hadn't been working there for very long when she quit. (U ishdan bo'shaganida u yerda ko'pdan beri ishlamayotgan edi.) 🔹 It hadn't been raining much, so the roads were dry. (Ko'p yomg'ir yog'mayotgan edi, shuning uchun yo'llar quruq edi.) 🔹 We hadn't been living in Tashkent for a year when we bought the house. (Uy sotib olganimizda Toshkentda hali bir yil ham yashamayotgan edik.) ❗ Muhim eslatma: Inkor shaklidagi not yuklamasining o'rniga e'tibor bering! U har doim birinchi yordamchi fe'l — had so'zidan keyin qo'yiladi. ✅ hadn't been studying ❌ had been not studying (Bu xato hisoblanadi!)
parts.4: ❓ Past Perfect Continuous: So'roq gaplar (4/5-qism) 📌 Bugungi darsimizda Past Perfect Continuous zamonida so'roq gaplar hosil qilish qoidalarini ko'rib chiqamiz. Ushbu tuzilma o'tmishdagi muayyan vaqtgacha davom etgan harakat haqida so'rash uchun ishlatiladi. ⚙️ Umumiy so'roq gap formulasi: Had + ega + been + V-ing...? 🔎 Maxsus so'roq gap formulasi: Wh-so'z + had + ega + been + V-ing...? 📝 Amaliy misollar: 🗣️ Had you been waiting for a long time before the bus arrived? (Avtobus kelguncha uzoq vaqt kutayotgan edingizmi?) 🗣️ Had she been working at that company for three years before she quit? (U ishdan bo'shashidan oldin u yerda uch yil ishlayotgan edimi?) 🗣️ How long had they been discussing the problem before they found a solution? (Yechim topishlaridan oldin ular muammoni qancha vaqt muhokama qilishayotgan edi?) 🗣️ Why had he been running so fast before he stopped? (U to'xtashidan oldin nimaga bunchalik tez yugurayotgan edi?) 💡 Muhim eslatma: So'roq gap tuzishda had yordamchi fe'li har doim egadan oldinga o'tkaziladi, been esa fe me'yorida asosiy fe'lning -ing shakli bilan birga egadan keyin qoladi.
parts.5: 🎓 Past Perfect Continuous (5/5-qism: Amaliyot va yakun) 📌 Ko'p uchraydigan xatolar: 1. Statik fe'llarni (stative verbs: know, love, want, believe) hech qachon davomli zamonlarda ishlatmang. Ular bilan Past Perfect Continuous emas, balki Past Perfect qo'llanadi. Xato: We had been knowing him for ten years. To'g'ri: We had known him for ten years. 2. Harakatning davomiyligi (for, since) ko'rsatilmagan va oddiy ketma-ket sodir bo'lgan o'tmish voqealari uchun bu zamonni ishlatmang. Bunday holatda Past Simple yetarli bo'ladi. 📝 Amaliy mashq: Qavs ichidagi fe'llarni Past Perfect Continuous zamoniga qo'yib, bo'sh joylarni to'ldiring: 1. She was exhausted because she ___ (work) in the garden for five hours. 2. How long ___ you ___ (wait) for the bus before it finally arrived? 3. They ___ (not / play) tennis for long when it started to rain. 4. James lost his voice because he ___ (shout) at the match all evening. ✅ Javoblar: 1. had been working 2. had ... been waiting 3. had not been playing (yoki hadn't been playing) 4. had been shouting

grammar_archive.topic: Passive reporting structures (It is said that..., He is known to...)

parts.1: 📌 Passive Reporting Structures: Umumiy tushuncha (1/5) 📖 Rasmiy nutqda va yangiliklarda ma'lumot manbayi noma'lum bo'lsa yoki uni oshkor qilish shart bo'lmasa, passive reporting structures ishlatiladi. Bu tuzilmalar orqali shaxsiy fikr emas, balki ko'pchilik orasida tarqalgan xabar yoki umumiy haqiqatlar yetkaziladi. Qoida asosan say, believe, know va think kabi fe'llar yordamida yasaladi. Ushbu mavzuni o'zlashtirish ingliz tilidagi nutq va matnlaringizni yanada rasmiy hamda akademik qilishga yordam beradi. 💡 Misollar: 🗣️ It is said that the company will open a new office. (Kompaniya yangi ofis ochishi aytilmoqda.) 🗣️ He is known to be a very talented doctor. (U juda iqtidorli shifokor sifatida tanilgan.) 📝 Keyingi qismlarda ushbu seriya bo'yicha darak, inkor va so'roq gap tuzilishlarini birma-bir batafsil ko'rib chiqamiz. Kanalni kuzatib boring!
parts.2: 📢 Passive reporting structures (2/5-qism) 📌 Bugun ushbu grammatik strukturani darak gaplarda qo'llashning ikkita asosiy formulasini ko'rib chiqamiz. 📖 1-forma: It + Passive verb + that + Gap Ushbu tuzilishda ma'lumot umumiy tarzda yetkaziladi va that so'zidan keyin to'liq gap keladi. • It is said that he lives in London. (Uning Londonda yashashi aytiladi.) • It was reported that the prices increased. (Narxlar oshgani haqida xabar berildi.) 📖 2-forma: Ega + Passive verb + To-infinitive Ushbu tuzilishda xabar ob'yekti gapning egasi bo'lib keladi va unga fe'lning to-infinitive shakli ergashadi. • He is known to be a very talented doctor. (U juda iqtidorli shifokor sifatida tanilgan.) • She is believed to have completed the task. (U topshiriqni yakunlagan deb hisoblanadi.) ❗ Tez-tez uchraydigan xato: Ikkinchi tuzilishda fe me'yorida to yuklamasini tushirib qoldirish juda katta xatodir. Masalan, He is known be emas, albatta He is known to be ko'rinishida yozish shart.
parts.3: 📚 Passive Reporting Structures: Inkor shakllari (3/5) 📌 Bugungi darsimizda ushbu grammatik tuzilmaning inkor shakli (negative form) qanday hosil qilinishini ko'rib chiqamiz. 💡 Asosiy formulalar: • It + is/was not + V3 + that + gap... • Ega + am/is/are/was/were not + V3 + to + V1... 📝 Misollar: • It is not believed that the news is authentic. Bu xabarning chin ekanligiga ishonishmaydi. • He is not expected to leave the country this week. Uning bu hafta mamlakatni tark etishi kutilmayapti. • They were not thought to have made any serious mistakes. Ularning biror jiddiy xato qilgani haqida o'ylashmagan edi. • The new rule is not known to cause any problems. Yangi qoidaning biror muammo keltirib chiqarishi ma'lum emas. ❗ Muhim eslatma: Inkor yuklamasi (not) joylashgan o'rniga e'tibor bering. Masalan: He is said not to agree (Uning rozi emasligi aytiladi) iborasi He is not said to agree (Uning rozi ekani aytilmaydi) iborasidan ma'no jihatdan farq qiladi.
parts.4: 📌 Passive Reporting Structures: So'roq gaplar (4/5) 🔎 Bugungi darsimizda Passive Reporting Structures iboralarida so'roq gaplar hosil qilishni o'rganamiz. Bu tuzilmalar yordamida mish-mishlar va umumiy qarashlar haqida savol beriladi. ⚙️ So'roq gap formulalari: • Umumiy so'roq (Yes/No): Is / Was + it + past participle + that...? Is / Are / Was / Were + Subject + past participle + to-infinitive...? • Maxsus so'roq (Wh- questions): Wh-word + is / are / was / were + Subject + past participle + to-infinitive...? 📝 Misollar: • Is it said that this ancient castle is haunted? (Bu qadimiy qasrda arvohlar bor deb aytishadimi?) • Is he known to be a very talented doctor? (U juda iqtidorli shifokor sifatida taniladimi?) • Was the company reported to have lost millions of dollars? (Kompaniya millionlab dollar yo'qotgani haqida xabar berilganmidi?) • What is expected to change after the new rules? (Yangi qoidalardan so'ng nima o'zgarishi kutilmoqda?) 💡 Eslatma: So'roq gap tuzishda yordamchi fe'llar (Is, Are, Was, Were) har doim egadan yoki it olmoshidan oldinga o'tkaziladi.
parts.5: 🎓 Passive reporting structures (5/5-qism) ⚠️ Eng ko'p yo'l qo'yiladigan xatolar: 1. O'tgan zamonda sodir bo'lgan voqea uchun oddiy infinitiv ishlatish. Misol uchun, kechagi voqea haqida He is said to leave yesterday emas, balki He is said to have left yesterday deyish to'g'ri bo'ladi. 2. It is... tuzilmasi bilan ega sifatidagi shaxsni adashtirish. Eslab qoling: It is said that... bog'lovchisi bilan, He is said to... esa infinitiv bilan ishlatiladi. 📝 Mavzuni mustahkamlash uchun mashq: 1. People say that he works hard. = He is said ___ hard. 2. They believe that the car was stolen. = The car is believed ___ stolen. 3. It ___ reported that the company is closing down. 4. She is known ___ a very generous person. ✅ Javoblar: 1. to work (hozirgi zamon uchun oddiy infinitiv) 2. to have been (o'tgan zamon majhul infinitivi) 3. is (standart It is reported that iborasi) 4. to be (known to be birikmasi)

parts.1: 📌 Future Continuous zamoni: Kelajakdagi jarayonlar (1/5-qism) 📖 Future Continuous (Kelasi davomli zamon) kelajakdagi ma'lum bir vaqtda sodir bo'layotgan va davom etayotgan harakatlarni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi. Bu zamon orqali biz kelajakdagi aniq bir lahzada inson nima qilayotgan bo'lishini ko'rsatib beramiz. Oddiy kelasi zamondan farqli o'laroq, bu yerda harakatning davomiyligi va aniq vaqt belgisi muhim hisoblanadi. Agar kelajakda davom etadigan jarayonni tasvirlamoqchi bo'lsangiz, ushbu qoida sizga juda qo'l keladi. 💡 Ma'noni yaxshiroq tushunish uchun misollarga e'tibor bering: 🗣️ Tomorrow at 5 PM, I will be playing football. (Ertaga soat 5 da men futbol o'ynayotgan bo'laman.) 🗣️ At this time next week, we will be flying to London. (Kelasi hafta ushbu vaqtda biz Londonga uchib ketayotgan bo'lamiz.) 📝 Ushbu seriyamizning keyingi qismlarida Future Continuous zamonida darak, inkor va so'roq gaplarni to'g'ri tuzish qoidalarini alohida ko'rib chiqamiz. Kanayimizni kuzatib boring!
parts.2: 📌 Future Continuous: Darak gaplar (2/5-qism) 💡 Bugun Future Continuous zamonida darak gaplar qanday tuzilishini ko'rib chiqamiz. Bu zamon kelajakdagi belgilangan biror vaqtda davom etayotgan harakatni ifodalaydi. 📐 Darak gap formulasi: Subject + will be + Verb-ing 🗣️ Misollar: 🔹 I will be studying at 8 PM tomorrow. (Ertaga soat 8 da men dars qilayotgan bo'laman.) 🔹 They will be playing football at this time next Sunday. (Kelasi yakshanba shu vaqtda ular futbol o'ynayotgan bo'lishadi.) 🔹 She will be working all day tomorrow. (U ertaga kun bo'yi ishlayotgan bo'ladi.) 🔹 We will be traveling to Samarkand at 5 o'clock. (Soat 5 da biz Samarqandga ketayotgan bo'lamiz.) ❗ Tez-tez uchraydigan xato: Boshlovchilar ba'zan will be o'rniga egaga qarab will am/is/are ishlatib qo'yishadi. Har qanday ega (I, he, she, they) uchun faqat will be birikmasi ishlatiladi.
parts.3: 📌 Future Continuous: Inkor gaplar (3/5-qism) 💡 Bugun kelajakda ma'lum bir vaqtda davom etmayotgan harakatlarni ifodalash uchun inkor shaklini o'rganamiz. 📖 Inkor gap formulasi: Subject + will not (won't) + be + Verb-ing 🗣️ Misollar: 🔹 I won't be sleeping at 10 PM tonight. (Bugun tunda soat 22:00 da men uxlamayotgan bo'laman.) 🔹 She won't be working this Sunday afternoon. (Bu yakshanba tushdan keyin u ishlamayotgan bo'ladi.) 🔹 We won't be playing football at 5 o'clock. (Soat 5 da biz futbol o'ynamayotgan bo'lamiz.) 🔹 They won't be traveling next week. (Kelasi hafta ular sayohat qilmayotgan bo'lishadi.) ❗ Tez-tez uchraydigan xato: Inkor yuklamasi not har doim will va be so'zlari orasiga qo'yiladi. Uni be fe'lidan keyinga o'tkazib yubormang! ❌ Noto'g'ri: He will be not cooking. ✅ To'g'ri: He won't be cooking.
parts.4: ❓ Future Continuous: So'roq gap tuzilishi (4/5-qism) 📌 So'roq gaplar qanday tuziladi? Future Continuous zamonida so'roq gap hosil qilish uchun will yordamchi fe'li egadan oldinga o'tkaziladi. 1. Umumiy so'roq (Yes/No questions): Will + ega + be + V-ing...? 2. Maxsus so'roq (Wh- questions): Wh-word + will + ega + be + V-ing...? 📝 Misollar: ❓ Will you be working at 8 p.m. tonight? (Bugun kechki soat 8 da ishlayotgan bo'lasanmi?) ❓ Will they be waiting for us at the station? (Ular vokzalda bizni kutayotgan bo'lishadimi?) ❓ What will you be doing at this time tomorrow? (Ertaga shu vaqtda nima qilayotgan bo'lasan?) ❓ Where will she be studying next year? (U kelasi yili qayerda tahsil olayotgan bo'ladi?) 💡 Eslatma: E'tibor bering, so'roq gapda faqat will yordamchi fe'li egadan oldinga o'tadi, be esa o'z joyida — asosiy fe'l (V-ing) oldida qoladi.

grammar_archive.topic: Subjunctive mood - zarurat va muhimlikni ifodalovchi that-clause'lar (It's essential that he be informed.)

parts.1: 📌 Subjunctive Mood: Zarurat va muhimlikni ifodalash (1/5) 💡 Ingliz tilida biror harakatning qanchalik muhim, zarur yoki shart ekanligini ta'kidlash uchun maxsus grammatik qurilma — Subjunctive Mood ishlatiladi. Bu tuzilma rasmiy nutq hamda yozishmalarda taklif, maslahat yoki talablarni ifodalash uchun qo'llaniladi. Uning asosiy xususiyati shundaki, that-clause tarkibidagi fe'l zamon va shaxsga bog'liq bo'lmagan holda dastlabki shaklda, ya'ni bare infinitive holatida qoladi. Uchinchi shaxs birlikda ham fe'lga -s qo'shimchasi qo'shilmaydi. 📖 Misollar: ✅ It is essential that he be informed. (Uning xabardor qilinishi juda zarur.) ✅ The doctor recommended that she take a rest. (Shifokor unga dam olishni tavsiya etdi.) 📝 Ushbu seriyamizning keyingi qismlarida Subjunctive Moodning darak, inkor va so'roq gaplarda qanday hosil qilinishini batafsil ko'rib chiqamiz. Kanalni kuzatib boring!
parts.2: 📌 Subjunctive Mood: Zarurat va muhimlik (2/5) 💡 Subjunctive mood (istak-mayl) ingliz tilida harakatning juda muhimligi, zarurligi yoki tavsiya ekanligini ifodalash uchun qo'llaniladi. Bugun darak gap tuzilishi bilan tanishamiz. 📝 Darak gap formulasi: It is + adjective + that + Subject + V1 (fe'lning bosh shakli) yoki Subject + verb + that + Subject + V1 (fe'lning bosh shakli) 🔤 Misollar: 🔹 It is essential that he be informed immediately. Unga zudlik bilan xabar berilishi juda muhim. 🔹 The doctor recommended that she take a few days off. Shifokor unga bir necha kun dam olishni tavsiya qildi. 🔹 It is crucial that every student finish the project on time. Har bir talaba loyihani o'z vaqtida yakunlashi shart. 🔹 We insist that the manager attend the meeting. Menejer yig'ilishda qatnashishini talab qilamiz. ⚠️ Tez-tez uchraydigan xato: Subjunctive mood qo'llanganda ega he, she yoki it bo'lsa ham, fe'lga -s/-es qo'shimchasi qo'shilmaydi va is/are o'rniga har doim fe'lning bosh shakli be ishlatiladi. ❌ Xato: It is essential that he is informed. ✅ To'g'ri: It is essential that he be informed.
parts.3: 📌 Subjunctive Mood: Zarurat va muhimlik (3/5-qism) 💡 Subjunctive mood iboralarida inkor gap tuzish uchun don't, doesn't yoki didn't yordamchi fe'llari ishlatilmaydi. Shunchaki asosiy fe'l oldidan not yuklamasini qo'yish kifoya. 🔤 Inkor gap formulasi: It is + adjective + that + Subject + not + V1 📝 Misollar: 🔹 It is essential that he not be late for the interview. Uning suhbatga kechikmasligi juda muhim. 🔹 It is important that they not reveal the secret information. Ularning maxfiy ma'lumotni oshkor qilmasliklari muhimdir. 🔹 It is crucial that she not panic during the exam. Imtihon vaqtida uning sarosimaga tushmasligi o'ta zarur. 🔹 It is vital that we not waste any more time. Biz ortiqcha vaqt yo'qotmasligimiz hayotiy muhimdir. ❗ Eslatma va ko'p uchraydigan xato: Subjunctive mood gaplarida inkor shaklini hosil qilishda doesn't yoki don't ishlatish eng ko'p yo'l qo'yiladigan xatodir. ❌ Xato: It is essential that he doesn't be late. ✅ To'g'ri: It is essential that he not be late.
parts.4: 📌 Subjunctive Mood: So'roq gaplar (4/5-qism) 💡 Ushbu grammatik strukturada so'roq gap hosil qilish uchun faqat gapning asosiy qismi so'roq shakliga o'tkaziladi. That-clause ichidagi grammatik tartib o'zgarmaydi va fe'l har doim bosh shaklda (bare infinitive) qoladi. 🔤 Umumiy so'roq (Yes/No) formulasi: Is/Was it + sifat + that + ega + V1? yoki Do/Did + ega + fe'l + that + ega + V1? ❓ Maxsus so'roq (Wh-) formulasi: Wh-so'z + is/was it + sifat + that + ega + V1? 📝 Misollar: 🔹 Is it necessary that he be present at the conference? (Uning konferensiyada qatnashishi zarurmi?) 🔹 Did the manager insist that she complete the report today? (Menejer hisobotni bugun yakunlashini talab qildimi?) 🔹 Why is it essential that we sign the contract right now? (Nima uchun shartnomani aynan hozir imzolashimiz juda muhim?) 🔹 Was it crucial that the patient be examined immediately? (Bemorning zudlik bilan tekshirilishi hayotiy muhim edimi?) ❗ Eslatma: So me'yoriy so'roq gaplarda ergash gap (that-clause) ichida hech qachon do/does/did yordamchi fe'llari ishlatilmaydi va ega fe'ldan oldin keladi.

grammar_archive.topic: Quantifiers va intensifiers - miqdor va urg'u ifodalari (a great deal of, plenty of, such, so, quite, rather)

parts.1: 📌 Quantifiers va Intensifiers: Miqdor va urg'u ifodalari (1/5) 📖 Bugun ingliz tilida nutqimizni jonli va ma'nodor qilishga yordam beradigan muhim grammatik mavzuni boshlaymiz. Quantifiers (miqdor ko'rsatkichlari) otlar oldidan kelib, narsalarning qancha ekanligini ifodalash uchun xizmat qiladi. Intensifiers (urg'u iboralari) esa sifat va ravishlarning ma'nosini kuchaytirish yoki ma'lum darajada susaytirish uchun ishlatiladi. Ushbu so'zlarni to me'yorida qo'llash orqali fikringizni aniqroq va ta'sirchanroq yetkazishingiz mumkin. 💡 Misollarda ko'rib chiqamiz: 🗣️ We have plenty of time to finish the work. Bizda ishni tugatish uchun yetarlicha (mo'l-ko'l) vaqt bor. 🗣️ This story is so interesting that I cannot stop reading. Bu voqea shunchalik qiziqki, o'qishdan to'xtay olmayapman. 📝 Keyingi qismlarda a great deal of, plenty of, such, so, quite hamda rather so'zlarining darak, inkor va so'roq gaplarda qanday shakllanishini alohida-alohida batafsil o'rganamiz.
parts.2: 📌 Grammar Time: Quantifiers va Intensifiers (2/5-qism) Bugun darak gaplarda miqdor (quantifiers) va urg'u (intensifiers) beruvchi iboralarning to'g'ri qo'llanishini ko'rib chiqamiz. 📚 Darak gap formulalari: • Subject + Verb + a great deal of / plenty of + Noun (A great deal of faqat sanalmaydigan otlar bilan, plenty of esa sanaladigan va sanalmaydigan otlar bilan ishlatiladi) • Subject + Verb + so / quite / rather + Adjective / Adverb • Subject + Verb + such + (a/an) + Adjective + Noun 💡 Misollar: 1. He spent a great deal of money on his new car. (U yangi mashinasiga juda ko'p pul sarfladi.) 2. We have plenty of time before the train leaves. (Poezd jo'nashidan oldin bizda yetarlicha vaqt bor.) 3. The weather today is so warm and pleasant. (Bugun ob-havo shunchalik issiq va yoqimli.) 4. It was such a great opportunity for my career. (Bu mening karyeram uchun shunday ajoyib imkoniyat edi.) 5. The test was quite easy, so I finished it early. (Test ancha oson edi, shuning uchun ertaga tugatdim.) ⚠️ Muhim eslatma: So va such so'zlarini adashtirmang! So so'zidan keyin faqat sifat yoki ravish keladi (so intelligent), such so'zidan keyin esa albatta ot qatnashishi kerak (such an intelligent student).

grammar_archive.topic: Modals for deduction and speculation (must have, might have, could have)

parts.1: 📌 O'tgan zamondagi taxminlar: Modals for deduction (1/5-qism) 💡 Kundalik hayotimizda o'tib ketgan voqea-hodisalarga nisbatan tez-tez taxminlar bildiramiz. Masalan, do'stimiz darsga kelmaganida, u kasal bo'lib qolganini yoki uyquda qolganini taxmin qilamiz. Ingliz tilida o'tgan zamondagi voqealar haqida mantiqiy xulosa chiqarish yoki ehtimollarni aytish uchun must have, might have va could have iboralaridan foydalaniladi. Ushbu qoida orqali siz o'z fikringizga qanchalik ishonchingiz komil ekanligini aniq va ravon ifodalay olasiz. 📖 Oddiy misollar: 🗣️ She must have forgotten about the meeting. (U uchrashuv haqida unutgan bo'lsa kerak.) 🗣️ He might have lost his keys in the park. (U kalitlarini bog'da yo'qotib qo'ygan bo'lishi mumkin.) 📝 Seriyamizning keyingi qismlarida ushbu modal fe'llarning darak, inkor va so'roq gaplardagi tuzilishini hamda ularning farqlarini batafsil ko'rib chiqamiz.
parts.2: 📌 Grammar Series: Modals for deduction (2/5) — Darak gaplar 💡 O'tgan zamondagi xulosa va taxminlarni darak gapda ifodalash uchun quyidagi strukturadan foydalanamiz: 👉 Ega + must / might / could + have + V3 (Past Participle) Bu iboralar taxminimizning qanchalik aniqligiga qarab ishlatiladi: • Must have — deyarli 100% ishonch bilan qilingan xulosa (shunday bo'lgani aniq). • Might / Could have — ehtimol, shunday bo'lgan bo'lishi mumkin (taxminiy). 🗣️ Misollar: 🔹 She looks so happy. She must have passed the exam. U juda xursand ko'rinadi. Imtihondan o'tgan bo'lsa kerak. 🔹 The streets are wet. It must have rained last night. Ko'chalar ho'l. Kechasi yomg'ir yog'gan bo'lishi kerak. 🔹 I can't find my wallet. I might have left it in the car. Hamyonimni topolmayapman. Uni mashinada qoldirgan bo'lishim mumkin. 🔹 He didn't answer the phone. He could have been busy. U telefonga javob bermadi. U band bo'lgan bo'lishi mumkin. ❗ Muhim eslatma: Modal fe'llardan so me'zoniy tartibda o'tgan zamon uchun har doim fe'lning boshlang'ich shakli — have keladi. Ega he, she, it bo'lsa ham, hech qachon has ishlatilmaydi! ❌ She must has gone home. ✅ She must have gone home.
parts.3: 📌 Grammar Time: Past Deduction (3/5) — Inkor shakli 💡 O'tgan zamonga oid taxminlarning inkor shaklini (Negative) hosil qilish uchun quyidagi formulalardan foydalanamiz: 👉 Mantiqan mutlaqo imkonsiz holatlar uchun: Subject + can't / couldn't + have + V3 👉 Ehtimol sodir bo'lmagan hodisalar uchun: Subject + might not / may not + have + V3 📝 Misollar: 🔹 He can't have seen me because I was hiding. (U meni ko'rgan bo me'yoriy jihatdan mumkin emas, chunki men yashiringan edim.) 🔹 She couldn't have stolen the money; she wasn't at work. (U pulni o'g'irlagan bo'lishi imkonsiz, u ishda yo'q edi.) 🔹 They might not have received our email yet. (Ular hali bizning xatimizni olmagan bo'lishlari mumkin.) 🔹 Sarah may not have noticed the mistake in the document. (Sara hujjatdagi xatoni payqamagan bo'lishi ehtimoldan xoli emas.) ❗ Muhim eslatma: O'tgan zamondagi mantiqiy imkonsizlikni ifodalashda must not have birikmasi o'rniga har doim can't have yoki couldn't have iborasini ishlatish to'g'ri bo'ladi.
parts.4: 📌 O'tgan zamondagi taxminlar: So'roq gaplar (4/5-qism) 💡 O'tgan zamonda sodir bo'lgan voqealar haqida taxminiy so'rov berish uchun modal fe'llardan so'roq shaklida foydalanamiz. 📖 Umumiy so'roq gaplar formulasi (Yes/No questions): Modal fe'l (Could/Might) + Ega + have + V3 (Past Participle) ...? 🔤 Maxsus so'roq gaplar formulasi (Wh- questions): So'roq so'zi (Wh-) + modal fe'l + Ega + have + V3 ...? 🗣️ Misollar: 1. Could he have forgotten about our important meeting? U muhim uchrashuvimiz haqida unutgan bo'lishi mumkinmi? 2. Might they have missed the last bus yesterday? Ular kecha oxirgi avtobusga kechikkan bo'lishlari mumkinmi? 3. Where could she have hidden the keys? U kalitlarni qayerga yashirgan bo'lishi mumkin? 4. Why might he have left the party so early? U nega ziyofatni bunday barvaqt tark etgan bo'lishi mumkin? ❗ Muhim eslatma: O'tgan zamondagi taxminiy so'roq gaplarda asosan could have va might have iboralari ishlatiladi. Qat'iy taxminni bildiruvchi must have birikmasi esa so'roq shaklida deyarli qo'llanilmaydi.
parts.5: 🎯 Grammar Series: Modals for Deduction (5/5) ⚠️ Ko'p qilinadigan xatolar: 1. O'tgan zamondagi taxminlar uchun modaldan so'ng fe'lning oddiy shaklini ishlatish xatodir. Masalan, he must be there yesterday emas, he must have been there yesterday bo'lishi kerak. 2. O'tmishdagi imkonsiz hodisani inkor qilishda mustn't have emas, balki can't have yoki couldn't have iborasi ishlatiladi. 📝 Bo'sh joylarni to'g'ri modal fe'llar bilan to'ldiring: 1. The grass is wet. It ___ (rain) last night. 2. She didn't answer my call. She ___ (be) busy, but I am not sure. 3. He ___ (commit) the crime because he was in another country at that time. 4. Wow, she got 100% on the test! She ___ (study) very hard. ✅ Javoblar: 1. must have rained (Aniq dalilga asoslangan kuchli xulosa) 2. might have been / could have been (Noaniq, ehtimoliy taxmin) 3. can't have committed / couldn't have committed (Mantiqan imkonsiz holat) 4. must have studied (Yuqori natijadan kelib chiqqan ishonchli taxmin)

grammar_archive.topic: Passive voice - turli zamonlardagi murakkab qurilmalar

parts.1: 📌 Passive Voice: Turli zamonlardagi murakkab qurilmalar (1/5-qism) 💡 Ingliz tilida harakat bajaruvchisidan ko'ra harakatning o'zi yoki uning natijasi muhimroq bo'lganda Passive Voice (Majhul nisbat) ishlatiladi. Murakkab zamonlarda ushbu qurilma nutqimizni yanada aniqroq, boyroq va professionalroq ko'rsatishga xizmat qiladi. Ko'pincha ilmiy maqolalar, yangiliklar va rasmiy muloqotda turli zamonlardagi majhul nisbat shakllaridan keng foydalaniladi. Ushbu seriyamiz orqali siz murakkab zamonlardagi majhul nisbat iboralarini muloqotda to'g'ri qo'llashni o'rganasiz. 📖 Keling, dastlabki misollarni ko'rib chiqamiz: 🔹 The new bridge is being built right now. (Yangi ko'prik ayni damda qurilmoqda.) 🔹 The report had been finished before the meeting started. (Majlis boshlanishidan oldin hisobot tugatib bo'lingan edi.) 📝 Keyingi qismlarda ushbu murakkab qurilmalarning darak, inkor va so'roq gap shakllarini turli zamonlar misolida batafsil ko'rib chiqamiz. Bizni kuzatib boring!
parts.2: 📌 Passive Voice: Turli zamonlardagi murakkab qurilmalar (2/5) 💡 Murakkab zamonlarda Majhul nisbat (Passive Voice) darak gaplarini yasash uchun tegishli yordamchi fe'llar hamda asosiy fe'lning V3 (Past Participle) shakli ishlatiladi. 📝 Asosiy formulalar: • Continuous zamonlar: Subject + be (am/is/are/was/were) + being + V3 • Perfect zamonlar: Subject + have/has/had + been + V3 • Modal fe'llar: Subject + modal verb + be / have been + V3 🗣️ Misollar: 1. The new document is being prepared right now. Yangi hujjat ayni damda tayyorlanmoqda. 2. All the tickets have already been sold out. Barcha chiptalar allaqachon sotib bo'lingan. 3. The bridge had been built before the winter started. Qish boshlanishidan oldin ko'prik qurib bitkazilgan edi. 4. This problem should have been solved earlier. Bu muammo ertaroq hal qilinishi kerak edi. ❗ Muhim eslatma: Aksariyat o'quvchilar being va been so'zlarini almashtirib qo me'yorini buzishadi. Davomli jarayonda har doim being, tugallangan natijada esa been ishlatilishini yodda tuting.
parts.3: 📌 Passive Voice: Murakkab inkor shakllari (3/5-qism) 💡 Majhul nisbatning murakkab zamon va modal birikmalaridagi inkor shaklini yasashda not yuklamasi har doim birinchi yordamchi fe'ldan so'ng qo'shiladi. 📖 Asosiy formulalar: • Perfect Passive: Subject + haven't / hasn't / hadn't + been + V3 • Modal Perfect Passive: Subject + modal + not + have + been + V3 📝 Misollar: 🗣️ The project hasn't been approved by the committee yet. Loyiha hali qo'mita tomonidan tasdiqlangani yo'q. 🗣️ The mistakes hadn't been noticed before the publication. Xatolar nashrdan oldin payqalmagan edi. 🗣️ The message shouldn't have been sent without permission. Xabar ruxsatsiz yuborilmasligi kerak edi. 🗣️ The building won't have been finished by the end of this year. Bino bu yilning oxirigacha qurib bitkazilmagan bo'ladi. ❗ Tez-tez uchraydigan xato: Inkor yuklamasini ikkinchi yoki uchinchi yordamchi fe'ldan keyin qo'ymang. Masalan, "should have not been" shakli xato, to'g'ri variant: "should not have been".
parts.4: 📌 Passive Voice: Murakkab qurilmalarda so'roq gaplar (4/5-qism) 💬 Bugungi darsimizda Passive Voice nisbatining murakkab zamonlar va modal fe'llar bilan kelgan so'roq gap shakllarini o'rganamiz. ⚙️ Umumiy so'roq (Yes/No questions) formulasi: Yordamchi fe'l + Ega + being/been/be + V3? ❓ Maxsus so'roq (Wh- questions) formulasi: Wh-so'z + Yordamchi fe'l + Ega + being/been/be + V3? 📝 Misollar: 🔹 Is the report being prepared at the moment? (Ayni damda hisobot tayyorlanyaptimi?) 🔹 Has the problem been solved yet? (Muammo hal qilindimi?) 🔹 Why has the decision been delayed for so long? (Nega qaror bunchalik uzoq vaqtga kechiktirildi?) 🔹 Can this task be completed by tomorrow? (Bu topshiriq ertagacha bajarilishi mumkinmi?) 💡 Eslatma: So'roq shaklida faqatgina birinchi yordamchi fe'l (masalan: is, has, can) egadan oldinga o'tadi. Boshqa elementlar (being, been, be) esa har doim egadan keyin qoladi.

grammar_archive.topic: Present Perfect Continuous (hozirgacha davom etayotgan harakatning davomiyligini ta'kidlash)

parts.1: 📌 Present Perfect Continuous: Hozirgacha davom etayotgan harakat (1/5) 💡 Bu zamon o'tmishda boshlangan va hozirgi paytgacha to'xtovsiz davom etib kelayotgan harakatlarni ifodalash uchun ishlatiladi. Uning asosiy vazifasi harakatning natijasini emas, balki aynan u qancha vaqt davom etganini ta'kidlashdir. Agar siz biror ish-harakatni ma'lum vaqt oralig'ida uzluksiz qilayotganingizni ko'rsatmoqchi bo'lsangiz, ushbu zamon eng to'g'ri tanlov bo'ladi. O'zbek tiliga ko'pincha "...dan beri bajarmoqda" yoki "...dan buyon qilmoqda" deb tarjima qilinadi. 📖 Misollar: 🗣️ I have been studying English for three years. (Men uch yildan beri ingliz tilini o'rganib kelayapman.) 🗣️ She has been waiting for the bus since 9 o'clock. (U soat 9 dan beri avtobus kutyapti.) 📝 Bugun ushbu zamonning umumiy ma'nosini ko'rib chiqdik. Keyingi qismlarda darak, inkor va so'roq gap tuzilmalarini batafsil o'rganamiz. Kanalimizni kuzatib boring!
parts.2: 📌 Present Perfect Continuous: Darak gaplar (2/5-qism) 💡 Ushbu zamon harakatning hozirgi paytgacha qancha vaqt davom etganini ta'kidlash uchun qo'llaniladi. 🔤 Darak gap formulasi: Subject + have / has + been + V-ing • I / You / We / They + have been + V-ing • He / She / It + has been + V-ing 🗣️ Misollar: • I have been studying English for three years. (Men uch yildan beri ingliz tilini o'rganyapman.) • She has been working at this company since morning. (U ertalabdan beri ushbu kompaniyada ishlayapti.) • We have been waiting for the bus for twenty minutes. (Biz yigirma minutdan beri avtobus kutyapmiz.) • It has been raining all day. (Kun bo'yi yomg'ir yog'yapti.) ❗ Muhim eslatma: Harakatning davomiyligini ko'rsatish uchun ko'pincha for (davomida) va since (dan beri) predloglaridan foydalaniladi. Ushbu zamonni Present Continuous bilan adashtirmang: Present Continuous ayni damda sodir bo'layotgan harakatni bildirsa, Present Perfect Continuous harakatning qancha vaqt davom etayotganini ko'rsatib beradi.
parts.3: 📌 Present Perfect Continuous: Inkor shakli (3/5) 💡 Hozirgi davomli tugallangan zamonda inkor gap tuzish juda oson. Buning uchun have/has yordamchi fe'llariga not inkor yuklamasi biriktiriladi. 🔤 Inkor gap formulasi: Subject + haven't / hasn't + been + Verb-ing 🗣️ Misollar: • I haven't been sleeping well recently. (Men oxirgi paytlarda yaxshi uxlamayapman.) • She hasn't been working here for very long. (U bu yerda unchalik uzoq vaqtdan beri ishlamayapti.) • We haven't been watching TV all day. (Biz kun bo'yi televizor tomosha qilmayapmiz.) • He hasn't been feeling well since morning. (U ertalabdan beri o'zini yaxshi his qilmayapti.) ❗ Tez-tez uchraydigan xato: Inkor gaplarda been so'zini tushirib qoldirmang! Masalan, "I haven't working" deyish grammatik jihatdan xato hisoblanadi. Har doim "I haven't been working" shaklida to'g'ri ishlating.
parts.4: 📌 Present Perfect Continuous: So'roq gaplar (4/5-qism) 🗣️ Bugun ushbu zamonda so'roq gaplar qanday yasalishini o'rganamiz. Bu shakl orqali biror harakatning qancha vaqtdan buyon davom etayotganini aniqlashtirib olishimiz mumkin. 📐 Umumiy so'roq gaplar (Yes/No) formulasi: Have / Has + ega + been + V-ing...? ❓ Maxsus so'roq gaplar (Wh-) formulasi: Wh-so'z + have / has + ega + been + V-ing...? 📝 Misollar: 🔸 Have you been waiting for me for a long time? (Meni uzoq vaqtdan beri kutib o'tiribsanmi?) 🔸 Has she been working at this company since 2020? (U ushbu kompaniyada 2020-yildan beri ishlayaptimi?) 🔸 How long have you been studying English? (Siz qancha vaqtdan beri ingliz tilini o'rganyapsiz?) 🔸 What has he been doing all morning? (U ertalabdan beri nima bilan mashg'ul bo'lyapti?) 💡 Eslatma: Present Perfect Continuous zamonida so'roq berganda eng ko'p ishlatiladigan birikma How long...? (Qancha vaqtdan beri...?) hisoblanadi. Javob berishda esa ko'pincha for yoki since ko'rsatkichlaridan foydalaniladi.
parts.5: 📌 Present Perfect Continuous: Amaliyot (5/5-qism) ⚠️ Ko'p uchraydigan xatolar: 1. Holat fe'llarini (stative verbs) ushbu zamonda ishlatish xato hisoblanadi. Masalan, "I have been knowing him" emas, balki Present Perfect ishlatilib, "I have known him" deyiladi. 2. Vaqt oralig'ini ko'rsatishda for (masalan, for 2 hours), harakat boshlangan aniq nuqta uchun esa since (masalan, since 8 o'clock) predlogi ishlatiladi. Bu ikkisini chalkashtirmang. 📝 Topshiriq: Qavs ichidagi fe'llarni Present Perfect Continuous shakliga o'tkazib, bo'sh joylarni to'ldiring. 1. She ___ (study) English for three hours. 2. They ___ (play) football since morning. 3. How long ___ you ___ (wait) for the bus? 4. It ___ (rain) all day, so the road is wet. ✅ Javoblar: 1. has been studying (uch soatdan beri dars tayyorlayapti) 2. have been playing (ertalabdan beri o'ynashyapti) 3. have / been waiting (qancha vaqtdan beri kutyapsiz?) 4. has been raining (kun bo'yi yog'moqda)

grammar_archive.topic: Mixed Conditionals (turli vaqtlardagi shart va natijalarni birlashtirish)

parts.1: 📌 Mixed Conditionals: Turli vaqtlarni birlashtirish (1/5-qism) 💡 Ingliz tilida standart shart gaplar muayyan bir vaqt doirasi bilan cheklangan bo'ladi. Ammo hayotda o'tmishdagi voqea hozirgi zamonga ta'sir qilishi yoki hozirgi vaziyatimiz o'tmishdagi natijaga sabab bo'lishi tez-tez uchraydi. Bunday hollarda bizga Mixed Conditionals (aralash shart gaplar) qoidasi yordam beradi. Bu tuzilma orqali o'tmishdagi taxminiy shart va uning hozirgi zamondagi natijasi bir gapda erkin bog'lanadi. 📖 Misollarga e'tibor bering: ✅ If I had studied harder at university, I would have a better job now. (Agar universitetda yaxshiroq o'qiganimda [o'tmishda], hozir yaxshiroq ishim bo'lar edi [hozir].) ✅ If she were not afraid of flying, she would have traveled with us last week. (Agar u uchishdan qo'rqmaganida [umuman/hozir], o'tgan haftada biz bilan sayohat qilgan bo'lardi [o'tmishda].) 📝 Ushbu seriyamizning keyingi qismlarida Mixed Conditionals turlari, uning darak, inkor hamda so'roq gap shakllarini bosqichma-bosqich ko'rib chiqamiz. Kanalimizni kuzatib boring!
parts.2: 📌 Mixed Conditionals: Darak gaplar (2/5-qism) 📖 Mixed Conditionals orqali turli zamonlardagi shart va natijalarni o'zaro bog'laymiz. Darak gaplarda eng ko'p qo'llaniladigan ikkita asosiy tuzilish mavjud. 🔤 1-Formula (O'tmishdagi shart ➔ Hozirgi natija): If + Past Perfect (had + V3), Subject + would + Verb 🔤 2-Formula (Doimiy/Hozirgi holat ➔ O'tmishdagi natija): If + Past Simple (V2), Subject + would have + V3 💬 Misollar: 1. If I had studied harder, I would have a good job now. (Agar o'tmishda qunt bilan o'qiganimda, hozir yaxshi ishim bo'lardi.) 2. If she had taken the medicine yesterday, she would feel better today. (Agar u kecha dorisini ichganida, bugun o'zini yaxshiroq his qilardi.) 3. If I were fluent in English, I would have applied for that job last week. (Agar men ingliz tilida ravon gapirganimda, o'tgan haftada o'sha ishga hujjat topshirgan bo'lardim.) 4. If we had booked the tickets earlier, we would be on the plane right now. (Agar chiptalarni vaqtliroq olganimizda, hozir samolyotda bo'lardik.) ❗ Muhim eslatma: Natija qismida hozirgi vaqtga ishora qiluvchi now yoki today kabi so mezonlar bo'lsa, would + Verb shaklidan foydalaning. Agar natija o'tmishga tegishli bo'lsa, would have + V3 iborasi ishlatiladi.
parts.3: 📌 Mixed Conditionals: Inkor gaplar (3/5-qism) 💡 Bugungi darsimizda Mixed Conditionals iborasida inkor (negative) gaplarni qanday to'g'ri tuzishni o'rganamiz. 📖 Inkor gap formulasini eslab qoling: 1️⃣ O'tmishdagi shart ➔ Hozirgi natija: If + Subject + hadn't + V3, Subject + wouldn't + V1 2️⃣ Hozirgi doimiy holat ➔ O'tmishdagi natija: If + Subject + didn't + V1 (yoki weren't), Subject + wouldn't have + V3 🗣️ Misollar: 🔹 If I hadn't missed the bus this morning, I wouldn't be late now. (Ertalab avtobusni o'tkazib yubormaganimda, hozir kechikib o'tirmagan bo'lardim.) 🔹 If she hadn't spent all her money yesterday, she wouldn't be broke today. (Kecha hamma pulini sarflamaganda, bugun pulsiz qolmagan bo'lardi.) 🔹 If he weren't so careless, he wouldn't have made that mistake yesterday. (U bunchalik beparvo bo'lmaganida, kecha u xatoga yo'l qo'ymagan bo mehmonga borgan bo'lardik.) 🔹 If we didn't live so far away, we would have visited you yesterday. (Biz shunchalik uzoqda yashamaganimizda, kecha siznikiga borgan bo'lardik.) ❗ Tez-tez uchraydigan xato: Shart qismidagi inkor vaqtini adashtirmang. O'tmishdagi voqea inkori uchun didn't emas, balki hadn't + V3 ishlatilishi shart. Hozirgi doimiy holat inkori uchun esa didn't + V1 yoki weren't qo'llanadi.

grammar_archive.topic: Whose, where, when so'zlarining yuqori darajadagi qo'llanilishi

parts.1: 📌 Whose, where, when so'zlarining yuqori darajadagi qo'llanilishi | 1/5-qism 💡 Kundalik muloqotda whose, where va when so'zlarini ko'pincha oddiy so'roq so'zlari sifatida ishlatamiz. Biroq yuqori (Advanced) darajada bu so'zlar murakkab gaplarni bir-biriga bog'lash va fikrni akademik uslubda ifodalash uchun xizmat qiladi. Ulardan to'g'ri foydalanish nutqimizni yanada ravon, aniq va ta'sirchan qiladi. Ushbu seriyamizda ularning barcha nozik grammatik jihatlarini bosqichma-bosqich ko'rib chiqamiz. 📖 Misollar: 🔹 This is the scientist whose research changed the world. (Bu tadqiqoti dunyoni o'zgartirgan olimdir.) 🔹 We have reached a stage where critical decisions must be made. (Biz muhim qarorlar qabul qilinishi kerak bo'lgan bosqichga yetib keldik.) 🔹 There are moments when action is better than words. (Harakat so'zlardan afzalroq bo'ladigan daqiqalar bor.) ❗ Keyingi qismlarda ushbu so'zlar yordamida darak, inkor va so'roq gaplar tuzilishining yuqori darajadagi qoidalarini batafsil tahlil qilamiz.
parts.2: 📌 Yuqori darajadagi grammatika: Whose, Where va When (2/5-qism) 💡 Nisbiy ergash gapli darak gaplar tuzilishi: • Noun + whose + noun + verb... (egalik ma'nosida) • Noun (place) + where + subject + verb... (o'rin-joy ma'nosida) • Noun (time) + when + subject + verb... (vaqt ma'nosida) Rasmiy va akademik ingliz tilida bu bog'lovchilar ikki sodda gapni birlashtirib, fikrni yanada aniq va ravon ifodalashga xizmat qiladi. 📝 Amaliy misollar: 🔸 Whose: The company, whose reputation was built on innovation, expanded into new markets. (Nufuzi innovatsiyalar ustiga qurilgan kompaniya yangi bozorlarga chiqdi.) 🔸 Where: We visited the facility where breakthrough medical research is conducted daily. (Biz har kuni muhim tibbiy tadqiqotlar o'tkaziladigan inshootga tashrif buyurdik.) 🔸 When: 2020 was the year when global communication shifted entirely online. (2020-yil global muloqot to'liqligicha onlayn formatga o'tgan yil bo'ldi.) 🔸 Whose: She is an author whose latest novel has achieved international acclaim. (U so'nggi romani xalqaro e'tirofga sazovor bo'lgan yozuvchidir.) ⚠️ Muhim eslatma: Where va when nisbiy olmoshlari ishlatilganda gap oxirida ortiqcha predlog (in, at, on) qo'llanmaydi. Masalan, "the city where I live in" iborasi xato hisoblanadi. To'g'ri shakli: "the city where I live" yoki "the city in which I live".
parts.3: 📌 Whose, where, when – Yuqori darajadagi inkor gaplar (3/5-qism) 💡 Yuqori darajadagi murakkab gaplarda whose, where va when so'zlari qatnashgan ergash gaplarni inkor shaklda tuzish formulasi: Ega + fe'l + whose/where/when + Ega + yordamchi fe'l + not + asosiy fe'l 📝 Misollar: 📖 I know a candidate whose background wasn't verified properly. Men ma'lumotlari yetarlicha running va tekshirilmagan nomzodni taniyman. 📖 We visited a town where tourists don't usually go in winter. Biz qishda sayyohlar odatda bormaydigan shaharchaga tashrif buyurdik. 📖 She remembers the time when smartphones weren't popular at all. U smartfonlar umuman ommabop bo'lmagan davrlarni eslaydi. 📖 They hired an expert whose methods didn't require big investments. Ular usullari katta investitsiyalarni talab qilmaydigan mutaxassisni ishga olishdi. ❗ Keng tarqalgan xato: Ergash gap ichida so'roq gap tartibini qo'llash strictly taqiqlanadi. Yordamchi fe'lni where/when/whose so'zlaridan keyin darhol qo'ymang, u egadan keyin kelishi shart. ❌ Incorrect: This is the place where don't people feel safe. ✅ Correct: This is the place where people don't feel safe.
parts.4: 📌 Whose, where, when: Yuqori darajadagi so'roq gaplar (4/5-qism) 💡 Whose, where va when so mezonlari yordamida yuqori darajadagi (Advanced) so'roq gaplar tuzish formulalari: • Maxsus so'roq: Wh-so'z + yordamchi fe'l + ega + asosiy fe'l...? • Whose birikmasi bilan: Whose + ot + yordamchi fe'l + ega + fe'l...? 📝 Misollar: ❓ Whose responsibility is it to oversee the project completion? — Loyihaning yakunlanishini nazorat qilish kimning mas'uliyati hisoblanadi? ❓ Where in the contract does it state that we must pay in advance? — Shartnomaning qayerida oldindan to'lov qilishimiz shartligi ko'rsatilgan? ❓ When exactly were the financial reports submitted to the board? — Moliyaviy hisobotlar kengashga aynan qachon topshirilgan edi? ❓ Whose idea was it to alter the strategy at the last minute? — Strategiyani so'nggi daqiqada o'zgartirish kimning g'oyasi edi? ❗ Eslatma: Akademik va rasmiy muloqotda where hamda when so'zlari ma'noni yanada aniqlashtirish uchun ko'pincha exactly yoki precisely kabi ravishlar bilan birga qo'llaniladi.

grammar_archive.topic: Wish / If only - hozirgi vaqtdagi afsus va xayoliy istaklar

parts.1: 📌 Wish / If only: Hozirgi zamondagi afsus va istaklar (1/5-qism) 💡 Kundalik hayotda hozirgi vaziyatimizdan qoniqmaganimizda yoki biror narsa boshqacha bo'lishini xohlaganimizda Wish va If only iboralaridan foydalanamiz. Bu iboralar hozirgi zamondagi amalga oshishi qiyin bo'lgan xayoliy istaklarni va mavjud holatdan afsuslanishni ifodalaydi. Ularning ma'nosi bir xil bo'lib, o'zbek tiliga "qaniydi" yoki "koshki edi" deb tarjima qilinadi. Eng muhim qoida shundaki, biz hozirgi vaqt haqida gapirayotgan bo'lsak-da, grammatik jihatdan fe'lni o'tgan zamon (Past Simple) shaklida qo'llaymiz. 📖 Misollar: 🗣️ I wish I had a new car. (Qaniydi yangi mashinam bo'lsa.) 🗣️ If only she lived near here. (Koshki u shu yerga yaqinroq yashaganida edi.) 📝 Ushbu seriyamizning keyingi qismlarida darak, inkor va so'roq gap tuzilishini hamda grammatik nozikliklarni batafsil ko'rib chiqamiz. Bizni kuzatishda davom eting!
parts.2: 📌 Wish / If only: Hozirgi zamondagi afsuslar (2/5-qism) 💡 Darak gap tuzilishi: Hozirgi vaqtga tegishli afsus yoki amalga oshishi qiyin bo'lgan xayoliy istaklarni ifodalash uchun gapda Past Simple (o'tgan oddiy zamon) ishlatiladi. Formula: Subject + wish(es) + Subject + Past Simple yoki: If only + Subject + Past Simple 📖 Misollar: • I wish I lived near the beach. (Qaniydi men dengiz bo'yida yashasam.) • If only she knew the right answer. (Koshki u to'g'ri javobni bilsaydi.) • I wish I had more free time. (Qaniydi mening ko'proq bo'sh vaqtim bo'lsa.) • If only we were on vacation right now. (Koshki biz hozir ta'tilda bo'lsak.) ❗ Muhim eslatma: Rasmiy grammatikada barcha kishilik oloshlari (I, he, she, it) uchun was o'rniga were ishlatilishi to'g'ri hisoblanadi. Masalan: I wish I was rich emas, balki I wish I were rich shakli to'g'ridir.
parts.3: 📌 Wish / If only — Hozirgi vaqtdagi afsuslar (3/5-qism) 💡 Hozirgi vaqtda sodir bo'layotgan biror holatni inkor shaklda aks ettirish, ya'ni "qaniydi shunday bo'lmasa edi" deb afsuslanish uchun Past Simple grammatik shaklidan foydalanamiz. 🔤 Inkor gap formulasi: Subject + wish(es) + Subject + didn't + V1 If only + Subject + didn't + V1 / wasn't (weren't) + ... 📝 Misollar: 1. I wish I didn't have to wake up early every day. (Qaniydi har kuni erta turishim kerak bo'lmasa.) 2. If only it wasn't so expensive to travel around the world. (Qaniydi dunyo bo'ylab sayohat qilish bunchalik qimmat bo'lmasa.) 3. He wishes he didn't smoke so much cigarettes. (U shunchalik ko me'yoridan ortiq chekmaslikni xohlaydi.) 4. If only we weren't stuck in this heavy traffic jam. (Qaniydi bu tirbandlikda qolib ketmagan bo'lsak edi.) ❗ Eslatma va ko'p uchraydigan xato: Hozirgi haqiqiy holat tasdiq bo'lsa (masalan: I eat too much sugar), wish iborasidan keyin albatta inkor shakl (didn't eat) ishlatilishi kerak. Mazmunan hozirgi holatning teskarisi nazarda tutilayotganini unutmang.
parts.4: 📌 Wish / If only: Hozirgi zamondagi xayoliy istaklar – So'roq gaplar (4/5-qism) 🗣️ Boshqa insonlarning amalga oshmagan istaklari yoki hozirgi holatdan afsuslari haqida so'rashni xohlaysizmi? Bugun wish fe'li yordamida so'roq gaplar tuzishni o'rganamiz. 💡 Umumiy so'roq gaplar (Yes/No): Do / Does + ega + wish + ega + Past Simple...? 💡 Maxsus so'roq gaplar (Wh- questions): Wh-so'z + do / does + ega + wish + ega + Past Simple...? 📖 Misollar: ❓ Do you wish you lived in a warmer country? (Siz issiqroq mamlakatda yashashni istarmidingiz?) ❓ Does she wish she had more free time? (U vaqti ko'proq bo'lishini xohlaydimi?) ❓ Do they wish they were fluent in English? (Ular ingliz tilida ravon gapirishni istashadimi?) ❓ Where do you wish you were right now? (Ayni damda qayerda bo'lishni xohlardingiz?) ❗ Muhim eslatma: So'roq shaklida If only birikmasi ishlatilmaydi, faqat wish fe'li qo'llanadi. Shuningdek, savol Do/Does bilan boshlansa ham, ikkinchi qismdagi fe'l baribir Past Simple zamonida qoladi.

grammar_archive.topic: Future Perfect Continuous (kelajakdagi ma'lum vaqtga qadar davom etadigan harakat davomiyligi)

parts.1: 🇬🇧 Future Perfect Continuous zamoni bilan tanishamiz! (1/5) 📌 Future Perfect Continuous (Kelajak tugallangan davomli vaqt) kelajakdagi ma'lum bir vaqtgacha davom etadigan harakatning davomiyligini ko'rsatish uchun ishlatiladi. Bu zamon orqali biz kelajakdagi muayyan nuqtada harakatning qancha muddatdan beri sodir bo'layotganiga urg'u beramiz. Odatda gapda for (davomida) va by (vaqtga kelib) kabi kalit so'zlar birga keladi. Ushbu zamon kelajakdagi jarayonning davomiyligini ifodalash uchun juda qulaydir. 💡 Misollar: • By next month, I will have been working here for 5 years. (Keyingi oyga kelib, men bu yerda ishlayotganimga 5 yil bo'ladi.) • By 5 o'clock, she will have been studying for three hours. (Soat 5 ga kelib, u 3 soatdan beri dars qilayotgan bo'ladi.) 📝 Keyingi qismlarda ushbu zamonda darak, inkor va so'roq gap tuzilishini alohida ko'rib chiqamiz. Kanalimizni kuzatib boring!
parts.2: 🇬🇧 Future Perfect Continuous: Darak gaplar (2/5) 📌 Bugun ushbu zamonning darak gap (affirmative) shaklini va uning yasalish formulasini o'rganamiz. Bu tuzilma kelajakdagi ma'lum bir vaqtga qadar harakat qancha vaqt davom etgan bo'lishini ko'rsatish uchun ishlatiladi. 🏗️ Darak gap formulasi: Subject + will have been + Verb-ing 💡 Barcha egalar (I, you, he, she, it, we, they) uchun bir xil will have been birikmasi qo'llaniladi. 📝 Misollar: 🗣️ By next month, I will have been working here for two years. (Keyingi oyga borib, men bu yerda ishlayotganimga ikki yil bo'ladi.) 🗣️ By 5 o'clock, she will have been studying for three hours. (Soat 5 ga borib, u uch soatdan beri dars qilayotgan bo'ladi.) 🗣️ They will have been living in Tashkent for ten years by 2025. (2025-yilga borib, ularning Toshkentda yashayotganiga o'n yil to'ladi.) 🗣️ When you arrive, we will have been waiting for an hour. (Siz yetib kelganingizda, biz bir soatdan beri kutayotgan bo'lamiz.) ❗ Muhim eslatma: Ushbu zamonda harakat davomiyligini ko'rsatish uchun for va kelajakdagi chegara vaqtni ko'rsatish uchun by... iborasi tez-tez ishlatiladi. Asosiy fe'lga -ing qo'shimchasini qo'shishni hamda formuladagi been so'zini tushirib qoldirmaslikni unutmang!
parts.3: 📌 Future Perfect Continuous: Inkor shakli (3/5-qism) 💡 Kelajakdagi ma'lum bir vaqtga qadar ma'lum bir harakat ma'lum bir muddat davom etmayotganini ifodalash uchun inkor shaklidan foydalanamiz. 🔤 Inkor gap formulasi: Subject + will not (won't) + have + been + Verb-ing 📝 Misollar: 1. By next month, I won't have been living here for five years. Keyingi oyga kelib, men bu yerda yashayotganimga besh yil bo'lmaydi. 2. She won't have been working at this company for long when you arrive. Siz yetib kelganingizda, u ushbu kompaniyada uzoq vaqt ishlayotgan bo'lmaydi. 3. They will not have been studying for three hours by midnight. Yarim tunga kelib, ular uch soatdan beri dars qilayotgan bo'lishmaydi. 4. We won't have been driving for very long before we stop for lunch. Tushlik uchun to'xtashimizdan oldin biz uzoq vaqt mashina haydayotgan bo'lmaymiz. ⚠️ Muhim eslatma: Inkor yuklamasi (not) har doim faqat birinchi yordamchi fe'l ya'ni will dan keyin qo me'yorida qo'yiladi (will not = won't). Will have not been... shaklida ishlatish katta grammatik xatodir.
parts.4: 📌 Future Perfect Continuous: So'roq gaplar (4/5) 💡 Kelajakdagi ma'lum bir vaqtga qadar davom etadigan harakat davomiyligi haqida so'rash uchun so'roq gap shaklidan foydalanamiz. 🔤 Gap tuzilishi formulalari: Umumiy so'roq (Yes/No questions): Will + egasi + have been + V-ing ...? Maxsus so'roq (Wh- questions): Wh-so'z + will + egasi + have been + V-ing ...? 🗣️ Misollar bilan ko'rib chiqamiz: 1. Will you have been working here for five years by next month? (Kelgusi oyga borib bu yerda ishlayotganingizga besh yil bo'ladimi?) 2. Will she have been studying for three hours when we arrive? (Biz yetib borganimizda u uch soatdan beri o'qiyotgan bo'ladimi?) 3. How long will they have been living in Tashkent by 2025? (2025-yilga kelib ular Toshkentda qancha vaqtdan beri yashayotgan bo'lishadi?) 4. What will you have been doing for two hours before the meeting starts? (Majlis boshlanishidan oldin siz ikki soat davomida nima qilayotgan bo'lasiz?) 📝 Qisqa eslatma: So'roq gaplarda faqatgina birinchi yordamchi fe'l – will egasidan oldinga o'tadi. Have been birikmasi hamda asosiy fe'lning -ing shakli egadan keyin o'zgarmasdan qoladi.

grammar_archive.topic: Reported speech - buyruq, iltimos va savollarni ko'chirish

parts.1: 📌 Reported Speech: Buyruq, iltimos va savollarni ko'chirish (1/5-qism) 📖 Kundalik muloqotda biror kishining aytgan buyrug'i, iltimosi yoki bergan savolini boshqa bir insonga yetkazishimizga to'g'ri keladi. Bunday holatda ingliz tilida Reported Speech (o'zlashtirma gap) qoidalaridan foydalanamiz. To'g'ridan-to'g'ri aytilgan gaplarni ko'chirishda gap qurilishi, olmoshlar hamda zamonlar shakli muayyan tartibda o'zgaradi. Bu qoida nutqimizni tushunarli, ravon va grammatik jihatdan to'g'ri shakllantirish uchun o'ta muhimdir. 🗣️ Misollar: • Direct: "Help me, please," he said. "Menga yordam bering, iltimos," dedi u. • Reported: He asked me to help him. U mendan unga yordam berishimni iltimos qildi. • Direct: "Don't shout!" the teacher said. "Baqirmang!" dedi o'qituvchi. • Reported: The teacher told us not to shout. O'qituvchi bizga baqirmaslikni aytdi. 💡 Keyingi qismlarda ushbu mavzu bo'yicha darak, inkor hamda so'roq gap tuzilmalarining ko'chirilishini batafsil ko'rib chiqamiz. Kanalni kuzatib boring!
parts.2: 📌 Reported Speech: Buyruq va iltimoslar (2/5-qism) 📖 O'zganing buyrug'i yoki iltimosini darak gap shaklida yetkazishda say fe'li o'rniga tell (buyruq berilganda) yoki ask (iltimos qilinganda) ishlatiladi. Asosiy fe'l esa to yuklamasi bilan bog'lanadi. 🔤 Darak gap tuzilish formulasi: Subject + told / asked + object + to + V1 📝 Misollar: 1. Direct: "Open the window," she said. Reported: She told me to open the window. (U menga derazani ochishni aytdi.) 2. Direct: "Please help me," Tom said. Reported: Tom asked us to help him. (Tom bizdan unga yordam berishni iltimos qildi.) 3. Direct: "Be quiet," the teacher said. Reported: The teacher told the students to be quiet. (O'qituvchi o'quvchilarga jim bo'lishni buyurdi.) 4. Direct: "Please call me later," Mary said. Reported: Mary asked him to call her later. (Meri undan keyinroq qo'ng'iroq qilishni iltimos qildi.) ❗ Tez-tez uchraydigan xato: Buyruq va iltimoslarni o'zlashtirishda that bog'lovchisini ishlatmang hamda to yuklamasini tushirib qoldirmang. ❌ Noto'g'ri: He told me that open the door. ✅ To'g'ri: He told me to open the door.
